lens: responsive task completion, hierarchy, accessibility, motion, and recovery
strengths: Rendered verification at 320, 390, 820, 821, 900, 1024, 1040, 1041, 1280, and 1440 pixels found zero horizontal overflow.
At 320 pixels the full-screen navigation scrolls to the request-access action; at 390 pixels all destinations and descriptions fit without scrolling.
Opening navigation makes main and footer inert, locks background scroll, places focus on the close control, closes with Escape, and restores focus and interactivity.
The source conversation precedes interpretation in the DOM and in the rendered mobile stack.
Horizontal evidence drag declares touch-action pan-y, preserving vertical reading, while click and keyboard Enter provide equivalent state changes.
Reduced-motion rendering removes drag travel and its visual prompt, retains a static selection path, and produces no hydration or console errors.
Light and dark desktop surfaces preserve the same hierarchy and direct-manipulation feedback.
